提示词审计编排 · prompt-audit-orchestration

Audit connected instruction systems by purpose, ownership, consumers, and observable effects.

This Skill coordinates on-demand audits across four related domains: Learning, Workflow, Hosted assistant, and Saved Task. It preserves separate domain judgment and source ownership while coordinating shared dependencies, one writer per mutable source, and evidence across each affected consumer.

Use and companion packages

Provide the complete prompt-audit-orchestration/ directory through your assistant's Skill mechanism. Its required companion Skills are prompt-and-skill-lifecycle for source authoring, integration, and publication, and agent-orchestration-master for agent roles, dispatch, coordination, and handoffs. They own their methods; this Skill keeps audit routing, domain authority, and completion judgment.

Use research when external evidence is material and task-inquiry when an unresolved user-owned choice needs to be framed. Learning audits may conditionally use local-teacher or web-teacher to understand the corresponding teaching method. Browser work may use browser-relay with the host's actual controlled browser capability. Download the needed companion directories; each retains its own configuration requirements. Host-native delegation support is a runtime capability, not a downloadable Skill dependency.

Package contents and boundaries

SKILL.md defines single-domain and joint audit routing, coordination, human-judgment relay, coverage, ownership-based repair, and evidence requirements. The four adapters in references/ preserve distinct domain scope and cross-domain source responsibility. The method is provider-neutral: resolve actual source owners, consumers, model policy, tools, and publication interfaces in the recipient environment. It adds no fixed model version, account, project identity, or mandatory approval step.

This package adapts a local orchestration method and removes its private host routes and named protected-project exception. It retains the general rule that any owner-declared protected target is evidence-only. Its paired agent-orchestration-master package is a separate companion, not embedded here.

This package uses the MIT License. Obtain the complete directory from GitHub.
